scripts.dev: echo '请在微信开发者工具中运行项目'
scripts.build: echo '微信小程序无需构建，直接编译即可'
scripts.clean: echo '清理临时文件...' && rimraf .temp dist
scripts.update:cloud-deps: echo '更新云函数依赖版本...' && node scripts/update-cloud-deps.js
scripts.install:cloud: echo '安装所有云函数依赖...' && cd cloudfunctions && npm run install:all
scripts.deploy:cloud: echo '部署云函数到云端...' && cd cloudfunctions && npm run deploy:all
scripts.check:versions: echo '检查依赖版本一致性...' && node scripts/check-versions.js
